reason: Free is nice, but "runs on your machine" with a sandbox for old Windows apps means me setting up Docker or Wine, and I don't install that kind of tooling myself. If our IT provider ran it for us I'd look, but I'm not doing it in a normal week.
objection: Setup weight. A sandbox that explores the app on its own sounds like a weekend of config before I see one diff, and I have no proof it understands our business app better than nobody does today.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click hosted or packaged version that our IT provider sets up, where I just upload a screen recording and get the diff report back.
